why: Authored best-guess districts are replaced for these codes by catalogue evidence with real tonnage (evidence.geojson, source "base-metals catalogue"); districts the catalogue does not cover are carried over unchanged as source "best-guess carried (base-metals)". For the minor metals (Sn, W, Mo, Bi, Hg, Sb) MRDS records are re-stamped per cell with a cap below the district level (source "base-metals mrds capped").
